step_count_rule: Mechanical replacement starts when the service opening is opened and ends after the post-replacement check; safety isolation is a mandatory precondition and is not counted as a mechanical step.

preconditions.action: Park on level ground, cancel the task, enter maintenance mode, and verify drive inhibit.
Apply electrical isolation or an approved equivalent energy-isolation state.
Place warning controls and verify that the maintenance zone is clear.

steps.action: Open the tool-free service door and expose the brush mounting interface.
Release the captive lock, remove the old brush, align the keyed replacement, insert it, and verify lock engagement.
Close and latch the service door, exit maintenance mode, and perform a low-speed no-load check.
Open the tool-free filter bay and verify that the fan and brush drive are stopped.
Remove the old filter, inspect the seal, insert the replacement in the marked direction, and verify retention.
Close and latch the bay, exit maintenance mode, and run a short no-load verification.

physical_acceptance.criterion: A non-maintenance operator completes each replacement in no more than three mechanical steps.
The operation is completed with an empty professional-tool tray.
Incorrect orientation cannot be latched or is rejected by an explicit mechanical cue.
The replacement remains retained after the frozen vibration and shock profile.
A remote task cannot release maintenance mode or re-enable motion.
